 Sunderland vs. Dinamo Zagreb - Head-to-head record
 Thursday’s match will be the first competitive meeting between Sunderland and Dinamo Zagreb . With no previous encounters to consider, there is no head-to-head record to help assess the fixture.
 Instead, the teams’ respective European campaigns and recent domestic performances offer the clearest indication of what to expect.
 Sunderland have made a promising start to their return to continental football, while Dinamo have struggled to find consistency, particularly away from home in Europe.

 Sunderland - Strong form in Europe
 Here’s a closer look at Sunderland’s current situation ahead of this European clash. We will explore their recent form, tactical approach, and the possible Sunderland vs. Dinamo Zagreb line-ups.
 Recent form
 The Black Cats are unbeaten in the Europa League , having collected seven points from their opening three matches. They began with a 1-0 home win over AZ Alkmaar, followed by a 2-1 victory away to Torreense and a 1-1 draw against Lech Poznan in Poland.
 That record has put Sunderland ninth in the 36-team league phase standings, giving them a realistic opportunity to challenge for a top-eight finish and automatic qualification for the last 16.
 Their domestic form has been considerably less convincing. A 3-1 defeat away to Coventry City last weekend extended their winless Premier League run to seven matches, with two draws and five defeats during that period. They also sit bottom of the English top flight after nine games.
 The hosts will have several selection problems. Daniel Ballard, Romaine Mundle and Habib Diarra remain injured, while Chemsdine Talbi, Jocelin Ta Bi, Melker Ellborg, Alan Browne and Aji Alese are ineligible for this competition. Nordi Mukiele is a doubt after missing the Coventry defeat due to concussion protocols, and Juan Angulo also needs to be assessed.
 Brian Brobbey could make way for Wilson Isidor or Timur Tutierov, while Kevin Danso, Thomas Meunier and Malick Fofana are among those pushing for starting places. Granit Xhaka is expected to play an important role in midfield.

 Dinamo Zagreb - Struggling for consistency on the road
 Let’s take a look at Dinamo Zagreb’s current situation. We will analyse their recent form, key matches, and the standout performers for their trip to England.
 Recent form
 Dinamo have taken four points from their first three Europa League fixtures. They opened with a goalless draw against Hapoel Be’er Sheva, then beat Anderlecht 1-0 before suffering a 4-2 home defeat to NEC Nijmegen.
 That latest loss leaves the Croatian side 18th in the league phase standings, three points behind Sunderland. Their domestic campaign has also suffered a setback. A surprise 1-0 defeat to Rudes last weekend led to the mutual termination of head coach Mario Kovacevic’s contract .
 Dinamo have won only one of their last eight European away matches, drawing four and losing three. That record makes Thursday’s trip particularly challenging, especially against a Sunderland side that have won both of their home matches in the competition.
 The visitors are expected to be without Scott McKenna, who is struggling with a back strain. Niko Galesic or Stjepan Radeljic should partner Sergi Dominguez in central defence.
 Dion Drena Beljo is the main attacking threat. He has scored 17 goals in 18 appearances in all competitions this season, including three in the Europa League, and is expected to lead the line again.

 Predictions for Sunderland vs. Dinamo Zagreb - home advantage to prevail
 Sunderland’s strong European home form contrasts with their domestic struggles, making them favourites here. Their defence has been solid in this competition, so the “ Under 2.5 Goals ” market is a compelling option.
 Dinamo Zagreb’s inconsistency, particularly on their travels, is a major concern for the Croatian side. Given their failure to score in their only away European match, a draw at half-time appears to be a realistic outcome.
 Considering Sunderland’s reliable performances at the Stadium of Light in Europe and Dinamo’s struggles on the road, our main prediction is for a home victory . The Black Cats have the momentum in this competition.
